css: .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1280px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; padding-left: 32px; padding-right: 32px; } .button { text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; grid-column-gap: 12px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #d4502a; background-color: #d4502a; color: #fffdf9; font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, transform 300ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .button:hover { background-color: #141613; border-color: #141613; transform: translateY(-2px); } .button.is-small { padding: 11px 20px; font-size: 14px; } .announce { height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #141613; color: #e8e1d5; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .announce-accent { color: #f08a5d; font-weight: 700; } .header-wrap { position: sticky; top: -38px; z-index: 100; } .navbar { position: relative; background-color: rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.1); } .navbar-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 84px; } .brand { text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 10px; color: #141613; } .brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: #d4502a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fffdf9; font-family: "Noto Serif JP", serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; } .brand-name { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .nav-menu { display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 36px; } .nav-link { text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #141613; padding-top: 6px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .nav-link:hover { border-bottom-color: #d4502a; } .nav-link.w--current { color: #d4502a; border-bottom-color: #d4502a; } .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 20px; } .nav-phone { text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #141613; } .menu-button { display: none; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #141613; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .menu-button-line { width: 18px; height: 1.5px; background-color: #141613; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .nav-menu { display: none; } .nav-phone { text-decoration: none; display: none; } .menu-button { display: flex; } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .container { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; } .button.is-nav { display: none; } }
